title: Minimum Total Operations
summary: Given an array of integers, you can perform operations by selecting a prefix and adding a chosen integer k to each element in that prefix.
statement: Given an array of integers, you can perform operations by selecting a prefix and adding a chosen integer k to each element in that prefix. Determine the least number of such operations needed to make all array elements equal.
constraints: One operation adds any integer k to every value in a nonempty prefix.
Return the minimum number of operations.
reference_solution:
def minimum_prefix_equalization_operations(nums):
    return sum(nums[i]!=nums[i-1] for i in range(1,len(nums)))
hints: A prefix operation is required exactly where adjacent values differ; it can fix that boundary without disturbing values to its right.
Each differing boundary is a lower bound and one matching prefix adjustment per boundary attains it.
editorial: Each differing boundary is a lower bound and one matching prefix adjustment per boundary attains it.

tests.explanation: The two adjacent boundaries differ, and two right-to-left prefix adjustments make all values equal.
The array is already equal and needs no operation.
